blurb: Standalone copy-paste prompts for employment and labor work — hiring, termination, worker classification, wage and hour, policies, handbooks, and international expansion. Each prompt runs on its own; the workflows offer a provisional mode if you have not built a Practice Profile. Every output is a draft for licensed-attorney review.

prompts.title: Employment Practice Setup
prompts.description: One-time interview that builds a reusable Employment Practice Profile — jurisdictional footprint, hiring and termination triggers, classification posture, escalation. Optional but recommended.

prompts.title: Hiring Review
prompts.description: Review one offer letter (and any restrictive-covenant exhibit) against your practice posture and the candidate's work jurisdiction.

prompts.title: Termination Review
prompts.description: Run the high-risk flag set against the facts, pressure-test severance and release, and produce a Go / No-go memo.

prompts.title: Worker Classification
prompts.description: Analyze a proposed engagement against the classification tests in the work jurisdiction — employee vs. independent contractor.

prompts.title: Wage / Hour Q&A
prompts.description: Answer one jurisdiction-specific wage and hour or employment question against your facts.

prompts.title: Policy Drafting
prompts.description: Draft one employment policy with state-supplement scaffolds for the jurisdictions in your footprint.

prompts.title: Handbook Updates
prompts.description: Diff a proposed handbook change against the current text and walk cross-references and state supplements for ripple effects.

prompts.title: International Expansion Kickoff
prompts.description: Frame the EOR-vs-entity decision for an international hire, draft cross-functional asks, and produce an outside-counsel briefing request.

prompts.title: International Expansion Update
prompts.description: Update an Expansion Tracker — apply changes, flag overdue items, surface unblocked dependencies, and re-check permanent-establishment risk.
